description: Source code defining the ChatAnthropic node class for integrating ChatAnthropic language models within a larger system. It includes class properties, constructor, load methods, and initialization logic for setting up the model with user inputs and credentials.

classes.name: ChatAnthropic_ChatModels
classes.description: Implements the INode interface to wrap around ChatAnthropic large language models, providing configuration, credential handling, and model initialization.

methods.name: loadMethods.listModels
methods.description: Asynchronously loads available chat models of type 'chatAnthropic' using the getModels utility.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ChatAnthropic model instance with parameters from nodeData, including credentials, model options, and multi-modal settings.
